source.title: 15. Management of Diabetes in Pregnancy: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026
source.organization: American Diabetes Association Professional Practice Committee for Diabetes

key_consistency_findings: Preconception A1C target below 6.5% is distinct from the pregnancy A1C goal below 6% when safely achievable.
Table 15.2 includes lower target bounds for type 1/type 2 diabetes and insulin-treated GDM, while recommendation 15.8 states upper glucose goals; both are retained without conflation.
Aspirin 100–150 mg/day is the chapter recommendation, with 162 mg/day listed as an acceptable option and explicit uncertainty about diabetes-specific preeclampsia efficacy.
Recommendation 15.25b contains both a usual stop/avoid rule and a high-risk exception; both were retained as distinct atoms.

semantic_findings: All numbered recommendation blocks from 15.1 through 15.32, including 15.25a and 15.25b, are represented in the SEA and atom set.
Split-grade recommendations were decomposed into independently reviewable atoms without collapsing evidence grades.
The two main tables were represented structurally and cross-checked against narrative thresholds.
Secondary trial and observational results remain labeled as secondary_reported_result and are not presented as primary-study extraction.
Appraisal scores were assigned only after source mapping, atom extraction, table reconciliation, and coverage review.
